rows.operator: Shape-matches the same 'lettered-suffix, lost parenthesis' pattern A4 hunts for ('8a' = digits '8' + letters 'a', with citation_grammar dropping the trailing '(5)' as an unparsed pinpoint, parse_status='partial'). Read independently before checking the evidence string: 7 U.S.C. §8 is real and does carry a subsection (a), so A4's structural test is factually true -- but '8a(5)' is the CFTC's own well-known shorthand for 'Section 8a(5) of the Commodity Exchange Act', and the Act's OWN section numbers are NOT the Code's: the Act's §8a is codified at 7 U.S.C. §12a, not §8(a). Confirmed by 12a's own printed source credit: '(Sept. 21, 1922, ch. 369, §8a, as added June 15, 1936, ch. 545, §10, 49 Stat. 1500 ...)'. This is the SAME family of hazard as the B8 1735f/1735f-14 episode -- a structurally well-formed, really-existing section that is the wrong referent -- except it fires inside A4's own rule, not B8's.
rows.publisher_heading:
uscode.house.gov 7 U.S.C. §8, heading '§8. Application for designation as contract market or derivatives transaction execution facility...'; (a): "Any person desiring to be designated or registered as a contract market or derivatives transaction execution facility shall make application to the Commission..." -- topically about REGISTRATION APPLICATIONS, not reporting forms.
TRUE TARGET: uscode.house.gov 7 U.S.C. §12a, heading '§12a. Registration of commodity dealers and associated persons; regulation of registered entities'; (5): "to make and promulgate such rules and regulations as, in the judgment of the Commission, are reasonably necessary to effectuate any of the provisions or to accomplish any of the purposes of this chapter" -- CFTC's general rulemaking authority, the natural umbrella citation for any CFTC rule including this one. Chapter 1's own table of contents (§8 ... §9, no entry between) proves no standalone §8a exists at all.
rows.decisive_quote: ABSTRACT: "Refresh content and automation of the CFTC Form 40 and 102 to fulfill current market surveillance information needs...consider adding data fields to Forms 40 and 102 to collect ownership and control reports (OCR)" -- a reporting-forms rule, not a contract-market-designation rule. The record's own sibling citations (ordinals 0-3: 7 USC 4a, 4c(b), 4g, 4i) are ALSO Act-style numbers from the Commodity Exchange Act's own '§4' family (§4a/4b/4c... are codified as 7 U.S.C. 6a/6b/6c...), and the oracle correctly refuses to 'correct' those three (base U.S.C. §4 is itself only a 'Transferred' stub per the chapter table of contents, so A4's own subsection-exists guard saves it there) -- §8 is the one case in this box where the coincidentally-real §8(a) subsection lets A4 manufacture a wrong survivor instead of refusing.
rows.why: The correct reading is 7 U.S.C. §12a(5) (Commodity Exchange Act §8a(5), the Commission's general rulemaking authority), not 7 U.S.C. §8(a). This is not a one-off: the SAME rule (RIN 3038-AD31) carries the identical '7 USC 8a(5)' citation and the identical wrong '8(a)' correction across five separate editions (201110, 201210, 201304, 201310, 201404), and a second, unrelated RIN (3038-AB50, three editions: 200004/200010/200104) cites the bare 'Act §8a' the same way and gets the same wrong '8(a)' correction. Across the whole class, CFTC (rin prefix 3038) supplies 11 of ~3,660 A4-corrected rows; 8 of those 11 (2 distinct RINs) are this exact wrong '§8a → 8(a)' defect.
